{{Quote|This&hellip; is only the beginning.''"<br />"''Yes. After a thousand years, Korriban is ours again. Welcome home.|Vindican and Malgus|<ref name="Return" />}}
The '''Battle of Korriban''' was a conflict that occurred in the early days of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the reconstituted [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], during which the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] fell back into the control of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Korriban was the ancestral [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Sith Empire, and had been a holy site and [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|training ground]] for adherents to the Sith religion since its inception. [[Millennium/Legends|Over one thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the Sith's [[Second battle of Korriban|defeat]] in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] and their subsequent [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] from Korriban, the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] users [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|returned]] to known [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the year [[3681 BBY]] and launched a [[Assault on the Aparo sector|brutal campaign]] for dominance in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] region. The attack prompted the Republic, which was severely under-prepared for such an assault, to rally its [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval forces]] and [[Tingel Arm campaign|send]] them into the Tingel Arm theater. The effort pulled [[Starship/Legends|defense vessels]] away from other planets, including Korriban, which was left without any substantive military defenses. A vigil over the world was maintained by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] alongside a small number of [[Republic trooper]]s, but that proved to be ineffective against the full force of the Sith [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|naval fleet]].

With an [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] of over thirty [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnaughts]], the Sith Empire invaded the [[Horuset system]] and engaged the small number of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Republic defenders in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Korriban. Aboard a Republic [[Korriban's orbital security station|space station]], Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Satele Shan]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Kao Cen Darach]], and several Republic [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] fought in vain against boarding [[Imperial soldier|Sith soldiers]] and Imperial [[Sith war droid Mark I|battle droids]]. During their attempts to escape Korriban and warn the Republic of the Empire's return, the Jedi and troopers were [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|met]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Vindican]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]]. 

Although Shan and her Master held the two off for a [[Time/Legends|time]], the younger Jedi was eventually forced to flee and leave Darach behind to fight alone. While she and [[Jace Malcom|one of the troopers]] escaped the station with the assistance of an incarcerated [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Nico Okarr]], Master Darach remained aboard and continued to battle the avenging Sith. The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Jedi was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Malgus during the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] and the remaining Republic and Jedi forces were annihilated, clearing a path for the Sith to return to their homeland. After a [[5000 BBY/Legends|thousand years]] of exile from the holy planet, the Empire retook Korriban and re-established it as a training ground, wherein [[Sith acolyte/Legends|students]] studied to continue the war with the Republic. Despite Shan's survival, the recapture was so efficiently and surprisingly performed that an extended period of time passed before the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] even learned of Korriban's loss. 

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Korriban shall be as it always was. A graveyard for the darkest of the Sith Lords, still whispering within their tombs. It shall always be a source of evil, spawning threats throughout the millennia. It, like Malachor, brushes the edges of the empire that waits in the dark. And like Malachor, the Sith have forgotten it &hellip; for a time. They will remember.|[[Kreia|Darth Traya]]|<ref name="KOTOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
The [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] served as the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], as well as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith religious order]] and its [[Sith Empire/Legends|Empire]], prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]<ref name="Korriban">{{Holonet|planets|korriban|Korriban}}</ref> of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Following the Empire's [[Second battle of Korriban|defeat]] in the war, the surviving Sith abandoned Korriban and fled into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] before returning to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] to build a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|revitalized Empire]].<ref name="Korriban" /> During the [[Jedi Civil War]], [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] reoccupied the world and used it as a [[Sith training|training]] ground for new Sith recruits.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> After the [[Battle of Rakata Prime|defeat]] of Revan's forces, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] seized Korriban and maintained a protective force around the planet. Over time, however, the fleet surrounding the world was gradually reduced, leaving only a token force of guardians to watch over the dark world.<ref name="JoGD" /> [[Standard year/Legends|Centuries]] later, the rebuilt Empire from the Great Hyperspace War [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|returned]] and initiated the [[Great Galactic War]] against the Republic in [[3681 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline6date" /> Early in the conflict, the Sith Empire launched a widespread campaign to secure [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] Outer Rim Territories. Their first concentrated effort was in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]], where the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] had already installed puppet governments on a number of worlds formerly allied with the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

[[File:Timeline6-OotSE.jpg|thumb|left|280px|The early success of the Empire's campaign pulled military resources away from worlds that would become easy targets for the Sith.]]
In response to the Empire's offensive, the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] organized a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to retake the Tingel Arm. Ignorant of the Empire's puppet governments, the Republic [[Tingel Arm campaign|haphazardly charged]] into the region and found itself deep in enemy territory. Republic military leaders, caught off-guard by the audacity and aggressiveness of the Sith advance, called upon every available [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in the [[Navy/Legends|navy]] to aid the fleet in the Tingel Arm, thereby leaving other strategically important regions in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] undefended. Korriban stood among the worlds that lost nearly all of their military defenses,<ref name="Timeline 6" /> and the Sith, eager to retake their home planet, decided that the holy world was a top priority in their campaign to seize the galaxy.<ref name="Korriban" />

Although the Republic Navy had abandoned the world, the Jedi Order chose to maintain a small but dedicated vigil over the planet, in an effort to guard its dark secrets.<ref name="Return synopsis">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/return|text="Return"|int=Return (cinematic trailer)}}</ref> Two Jedi&mdash;the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Satele Shan]]<ref name="Return" /> and her [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Kao Cen Darach]]<ref name="MasterLordNames" />&mdash;participated in the protection of Korriban from a [[Korriban's orbital security station|space station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above the planet. The two were joined there by a number of [[Republic trooper|troopers]] from the Republic's [[Republic Special Forces Division]], who also assisted the Jedi as a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] for the region.<ref name="Return" /> In the year of the Empire's return to the known galaxy, Shan, Darach, and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Jace Malcom]], traveled to the planet's surface to intercept a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that had landed without authorization. There they discovered [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Nico Okarr]],<ref name="JoGD" /> who was attempting to purchase [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]] of the old Sith Empire from the infamous grave robber [[Farel Wickes]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The Jedi and trooper impounded Okarr's vessel,<ref name="JoGD" /> the ''[[Redshifter]]'',<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> before he was able to flee the world and ferried him to the orbital security station<ref name="JoGD" /> where they were joined by a Republic trooper who helped to take Okarr into custody. As the four of them escorted the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] through the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], Shan sensed a considerable [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|ripple]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Return" />

==The battle==
===The return of the Sith===
{{Dialogue|Darach|The Sith Empire has returned... We must warn the Republic.|Malcom|Our shuttles can't outrun those fighters.|Okarr|Ahem. Well&hellip; guess who's got the fastest ship in the sector?|attr=Master Kao Cen Darach, Corporal Jace Malcom, and smuggler Nico Okarr discuss their escape from Korriban|src=<ref name="Return" />}}
At that moment, an Imperial [[Imperial Navy/Legends|armada]] of over thirty [[Harrower-class dreadnought|Sith battlecruisers]] jumped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]<ref name="Return" /> into the [[Horuset system]],<ref name="TEA" /> near Korriban and its space station. The [[Warship/Legends|warships]], having taken advantage of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] opened by the Empire's Tingel Arm campaign,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> immediately dispatched numerous [[Fighter wing/Legends|wings]] of [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|interceptor starfighters]] that began strafing runs on the Republic's station. The first few volleys inflicted heavy damage on the installation, causing reactive explosions throughout the station and setting fire to several internal areas of the structure. Shortly afterward, boarding parties consisting of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army's]] [[Imperial soldier|Sith troops]] and [[Sith war droid Mark I|assault droids]] landed on the station and engaged Republic personnel on board.<ref name="Return" />

[[File:Onslaught_of_the_Sith_Empire.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Sith forces ambush and overwhelm the Jedi.]]
Darach understood the gravity of the situation and decided that the defenders' first priority must be to warn the Republic of the Empire's new offensive. Corporal Malcom agreed, but informed the Jedi that their [[NR2 gully jumper|shuttles]] would have no chance of outrunning the Empire's much more agile [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptors]]. Having overheard the conversation, the detained smuggler offered his [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]] as a means of escape,<ref name="Return" /> given that it was the fastest ship in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]].<ref name="Esstran">In [[Return (cinematic trailer)|''Return'']], Okarr claims that his vessel is the fastest in "the sector," evidently referring to the region that Korriban occupied. According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', Korriban is located in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]].</ref> The Jedi agreed, and together with Okarr and [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], rushed to the station's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in hopes of reaching the vessel and informing Republic authorities of the situation. Upon reaching the hall that led into the hangar, Shan and her Master rushed ahead to clear the landing zone of Imperial troopers while the Republic soldiers brought up the rear, holding off pursuing Imperial forces. While the two soldiers were distracted, a Sith soldier launched a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] at them, [[Death/Legends|killing]] one and temporarily incapacitating Malcom. Witnessing the incident, the Captain drew his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and quickly killed four of the approaching Sith [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. Having regained his faculties, the Republic Corporal armed himself with a blaster [[Chaingun/Legends|chaingun]] and joined the smuggler to destroy two advancing [[Battle droid/Legends|assault droids]].<ref name="Return" />

As Imperial forces continued to make their way through the station, Okarr and Malcom retreated into the hangar, sealing the entry behind them to prevent any further intrusion from enemy troopers. Shan and Darach simultaneously finished eradicating the troopers who had already taken position in the hangar, allowing the four of them to regroup and examine the ''Redshifter'', which had been slightly damaged by the violent rocking of the station caused by the attacking vessels. The Captain lamented the state of his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], but reassured Darach that his vessel was resilient enough to take flight once more and flee the station. However, before any of the Republic defenders could board the vessel, a [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptor]] landed in the hangar and two Sith disembarked: an [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]]<ref name="Inquisitor" /> Sith Pureblood, [[Darth Vindican]],<ref name="MasterLordNames" /> and his Human [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], the [[Sith Warrior]] [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]]. Their primary goal was to prevent the Jedi and others from leaving the station to warn the Republic of the attack; the Jedi were determined to prevent the Sith from interfering in their escape. Shan and Darach [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] Malgus and Vindican in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] while Malcom and the Okarr rushed onto the freighter to prepare for lift-off with the Captain's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[T7-O1]].<ref name="Return" />

On the landing bay floor, the Jedi and Sith fought fiercely, with Malgus and Shan engaging one another while their Masters dueled a short distance away. During the melee, Malgus was able to outmaneuver Shan, ultimately disarming her before delivering a powerful knee thrust into her abdomen. While the young Jedi doubled-over from the impact, the Sith apprentice moved to finish her with an over-handed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] swing. Just as his weapon was descending to kill Shan, Master Darach, who was himself engaged in combat with Vindican, broke from his own struggle long enough to [[Telekinesis/Legends|throw]] his lightsaber in Malgus's direction. Malgus, who did not see the incoming blade, was caught off-guard by the impact of the Zabrak's lightsaber against his own. Shan used the borrowed [[Time/Legends|time]] to kick the Sith away from her and reclaim her lost weapon. She proceeded to make an attempt at attacking the Sith Lord, but Vindican swatted her away with a blast of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. In response, Shan's Master Force-pushed the Sith Pureblood across the hangar so that he might regroup with his Padawan.<ref name="Return" />

===A homeland reclaimed===
{{Quote|The Republic fleet suddenly found itself in enemy territory, fighting desperately on all sides. The Republic rallied every available ship to support the fleet, leaving only a handful of Jedi security ships to patrol Korriban. Regrettably, Korriban fell back into the enemies' hands without the Jedi Council even knowing about it.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
[[File:Jedi_Master_versus_two_Sith.jpg|thumb|left|330px|Kao Cen Darach engages Darth Vindican and Malgus simultaneously.]]
Meanwhile, Captain Okarr managed to bring the ''Redshifter'' online and lift off from the hangar bay. Malcom descended the ship's boarding ramp in an attempt to collect the two Jedi, but was instead met by the two Sith, who were trying to halt the starship with waves of Force lightning. The Corporal responded with an ineffective shot from a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] before turning his attention back to the Jedi. While he called for them to join him, Shan and Darach conferred; the Zabrak informed his apprentice that their paths were about to deviate, and that she must flee on the freighter while he remained behind to hold off the Sith. The young Jedi complied and furnished her Master with her own [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] before [[Force jump/Legends|leaping]] into the departing smuggler ship. While the freighter narrowly escaped the hangar, the Jedi Master re-engaged the two Sith. Wielding both his lightsaber and that of his apprentice, he drove the two back while expertly defending himself against their lightsaber and Force attacks.<ref name="Return" />

After slashing Vindican across the face, Darach deactivated one end of Shan's weapon and continued to perform agile flurries of strikes. Darach was eventually able to maneuver himself into a position that allowed for him to activate Shan's weapon [[Shiak|through the Inquisitor's abdomen]], thereby incapacitating him for the remainder of the battle. Malgus seized the opportunity to appropriate his fallen Master's weapon and reciprocate his opponent's usage of three blades with his own. Although the Zabrak attempted to prevent the apprentice's advance by hurling large chunks of debris toward Malgus, the Sith apprentice was undeterred, and cut through all obstacles with ease. Upon reaching the Jedi Master, the two engaged one another for a short time, but the young Sith ultimately prevailed. Malgus [[Sai tok/Legends|cut]] Darach in half horizontally, killing him.<ref name="Return" />

Meanwhile, Shan and Malcom used the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] turrets on the Okarr's freighter to destroy pursuing Imperial interceptors and [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]]. After clearing a small [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]], the smuggler flew the ''Redshifter'' directly toward several incoming Sith [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]], narrowly avoiding collision while simultaneously losing his pursuers. The freighter inflicted considerable damage upon one of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] before clearing the attacking Sith fleet and jumping to hyperspace. When Malgus was informed of their escape, he confronted his wounded Master and accused him of failure. Although Vindican disagreed that the battle was a failed venture, the apprentice disregarded the elder Sith's words and instead took the opportunity to kill his teacher.<ref name="Return" /> The planet's only other guardians&mdash;a small force of [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|Jedi security ships]]&mdash;were easily overwhelmed by Sith interceptors and destroyed.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> The invading Sith also captured Farel Wickes as he tried to flee the battle at Korriban, preventing the grave robber from getting away with the fortune he earned from Okarr.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Having wiped out the Republic and Jedi, the Empire cleared the path toward the planet's surface, where the Sith once again walked in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] and reclaimed their ancestral homeworld.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Retaking the holy planet of Korriban as a top priority, the Sith re-established the glorious Sith Academy and began training a new generation of Sith to inherit their dark legacy and seize their birthright as the true rulers of the galaxy.|A [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] dossier on Korriban|<ref name="Holonet Korriban">{{Holonet|planets|korriban|Korriban}}</ref>}}
[[File:Sith_seize_Korriban.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The Sith return to Korriban.]]
Despite Shan's escape from the battle,<ref name="Return" /> the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] had no knowledge of the Sith's return to Korriban for an extended period of time. The Republic meanwhile continued to lose ground in the war, facing [[Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)|devastating losses]] in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]], a [[Minos Cluster Campaign|Sith invasion]] of the resource-rich [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], and a [[Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route|blockade]] of the vital [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] in quick succession following the Korriban onslaught. In response, the Jedi Council and the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic attempted to formulate a defense plan in an [[Senate emergency defense session|emergency session of congress]], but the meeting resulted in [[Politics/Legends|political]] gridlock and failure.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> On Korriban, the Sith interrogated Farel Wickes for information on the tombs of Korriban, and after weeks of [[Torture/Legends|torture]], the once-successful grave robber succumbed to his injuries and died.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Over the course of the war, the Empire turned the dry and arid Korriban into a bastion for the training and education of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], re-establishing the world's [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] and dedicating it to the cultivation of a new generation of devotees who could continue the fight against the Republic.<ref name="Korriban" /> After participating in the capture of the planet, Malgus made several religious pilgrimages to the surface; during the first of those journeys, the Sith experienced a vision of the galaxy engulfed in flames&mdash;a sight that he understood as a symbol of the Republic's fall.<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> Korriban again became a battlefield in [[3678 BBY]],<ref name="BotEDate">According to ''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]'', the stories within the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire|''Blood of the Empire'']] series occur twenty-five years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the Treaty is ratified in [[3653 BBY]], placing ''Blood of the Empire'' and the events within&mdash;including the [[Battle over Korriban|second battle at Korriban]]&mdash;in [[3678 BBY]]</ref> when the renegade Sith apprentice [[Exal Kressh]] betrayed the Empire and allowed a fleet of Republic warships to launch a [[Battle over Korriban|failed attempt]] to retake the planet.<ref name="BotE 3">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 3: Burn the Future]]''</ref> Following the conclusion of the Great Galactic War with the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] made a [[Holodocumentary|holorecord]] documenting the opening battles of the conflict. In the record, the Jedi Master included the fall of Korriban and the events surrounding it.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> The Jedi Master also kept a [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|journal]] during the Great War that included a first-hand account of the Jedi's reaction upon learning that Korriban had been retaken. After ascending to the rank of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Jedi Order, Satele Shan submitted the journal, which now included her personal reflections on the war and the fall of Korriban, to [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="JoGD" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I am Darth Malgus&mdash;I fought in the Battle of Korriban. I turned the Jedi Temple on Coruscant to rubble. I will tell you what you "need."|Darth Malgus on the battles of Korriban and Coruscant|<ref name="TOR:IFHS">{{TORcite|type=other|[Intro] Flashpoint: Hammer Station}}</ref>}}
[[File:Battle_of_Korriban_Duel_JMGD.jpg|thumb|250px|The duel during the Battle of Korriban]]
The Battle of Korriban was created as a historical plot element for [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The event was first mentioned on the game's [http://swtor.com website], in Korriban's entry in [[The Holonet]]. The battle first appeared in [[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|''Onslaught of the Sith Empire'']], the sixth installment of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'' video series, published on the same website on [[January 22]], [[2010]].<ref name="News">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100122_001|text=Onslaught of the Sith Empire|nolive=1}}</ref>
